blocks.source: アンリミテッドサガ
blocks.translation: Unlimited Saga

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Substance / Story

blocks.source: ７人のキャラクターの中から主人公を選択可能。それぞれに異なるシナリオが存在する。
blocks.translation: You can choose the protagonist from among seven characters. Each has a different scenario.

blocks.source: 七大脅威と呼ばれるダンジョンの存在など、壮大な世界設定を感じさせる。
blocks.translation: The existence of dungeons called the Seven Great Threats and other elements give the world a grand sense of scale.

blocks.source: ……が、期待したほどのストーリーが展開されるわけでもなかった。各主人公のシナリオは小さくまとまっている。
blocks.translation: …But the story does not unfold as extensively as I had hoped. Each protagonist's scenario is fairly self-contained.

blocks.source: １人辺りのプレイ時間は１０時間程度。さほどテンポがよくない割りに短い。
blocks.translation: Each character's playtime is around ten hours. It is short despite its less-than-brisk pacing.

blocks.source: なお、筆者は６人までクリアしたが、マイス編だけはクリアしていない。全員をクリアすると歌付きのエンディングが流れるらしい。
blocks.translation: I cleared the game with six characters, but never completed Myles's scenario. Apparently, clearing all of them unlocks an ending with vocals.

blocks.source: システム／バランス
blocks.translation: System / Balance

blocks.source: 『技の使用』『宝の入手』『罠の解除』など、様々な場面でリール（ルーレット）が関わってくる。
blocks.translation: Reels (roulette wheels) are involved in various situations, such as using Techs, obtaining treasure, and disarming traps.

blocks.source: おなじみの閃きシステムは今回も健在。ただし、せっかく覚えた技もリールを止めることができなければ使用できない。とはいえ、戦闘中のリールに限っては慣れれば確実に止めることもできる。
blocks.translation: The familiar Glimmer system is still present. However, even a Tech you worked hard to learn cannot be used if you fail to stop the reel. That said, with practice, you can reliably stop the reels during battle.

blocks.source: 敵・味方共にＨＰが０になっても死なない。止めを刺すにはＬＰを０にする必要がある。ＨＰを減らしてからダメージを与えるとＬＰが確率で減少するという仕組みになっている。
blocks.translation: Neither enemies nor allies die when their HP reaches 0. To deliver the finishing blow, you must reduce their LP to 0. After lowering their HP, dealing damage has a chance to reduce their LP.

blocks.source: これにどういう面白みがあるのかは、ちょっと理解できなかった。ＬＰ減少が確率でバラけるので運ゲー臭がするのも不満。ぶっちゃけＨＰが０になったら倒れるほうが分かりやすいし、テンポも良いような……。
blocks.translation: I couldn't really understand what was supposed to be fun about this. I also disliked how the chance-based LP reductions make it feel like a game of luck. Frankly, having a character fall when their HP reaches 0 would be easier to understand and probably make for better pacing…

blocks.source: 今までと違い、戦闘に勝利しても、キャラクターの能力はその時点で上がらない。ダンジョンをクリアした際に、戦闘などそれまでの行動によってＨＰが上昇する。
blocks.translation: Unlike before, characters do not gain abilities immediately upon winning a battle. When a dungeon is cleared, their HP increases based on their actions up to that point, including battles.

blocks.source: また、７つまで保有できるパネル（スキル）を選ぶことができるのだが、これが微妙なランダム性を持っているため非常にやりにくい。望んだパネルが出るとは限らない上に、強制的に交換なので、現状より弱いパネルに泣く泣く交換しなければならないことも。
blocks.translation: You can also choose up to seven panels (skills), but their slight randomness makes this extremely frustrating. You are not guaranteed to get the panels you want, and since exchanges are mandatory, you may be forced to reluctantly replace one with a panel weaker than your current one.

blocks.source: 『合成術』なるパネルを入手すれば、様々な術が使えるようになる。しかし、普通に一度クリアした程度のプレイでは、お目にかかることすらなかったり、出てきても物理系のキャラクターに出てきて使いようがなかったりとチグハグ。ちゃんと使えれば強力らしいのだが、６周してもまともに使えた試しがない。いくら何でも出し惜しみしすぎだと思う。術好きの僕としては無念過ぎる。
blocks.translation: Obtaining a panel called “Spell Synthesis” allows you to use various spells. However, during a normal playthrough, you may never even see one, or it may appear for a physical character who has no use for it. The spells are apparently powerful when used properly, but even after six playthroughs, I never managed to use them effectively. I think they are being withheld far too much. As someone who loves spells, this is incredibly disappointing.

blocks.source: ダンジョンが長い割りに、セーブポイントが少ないため辛い。数時間、ダンジョンに潜った末に全滅してしまい、何度かやる気を失いかけた。難易度が高いのはいつものこと。だけど、従来のサガシリーズはそれをどこでもセーブなどの親切要素によって補っていたはず。今回はそういった配慮がないのが辛い。
blocks.translation: The dungeons are long, yet there are few save points, which makes them painful. After spending several hours in a dungeon only to suffer a party wipe, I nearly lost the motivation to continue several times. High difficulty is nothing unusual for this series. However, the previous SaGa games should have made up for that with considerate features such as saving anywhere. The lack of such consideration this time is tough.

blocks.source: 『全身鎧』という裏技のようなものを使うと一気に難度が落ちるけれど、一気に手応えもなくなる罠。もう少しどうにかならなかったのか……。
blocks.translation: Using a sort of cheat called “Full-Body Armor” drastically lowers the difficulty, but it also removes all the challenge just as drastically. Couldn't they have handled this a little better…?

blocks.source: サガシリーズにしては数値のインフレが抑え気味。キャラクターを成長させる快感が得られにくいので、ちと物足りないかも。戦闘に勝利してもすぐにはキャラクターが成長しない仕様のため、戦闘が面倒臭く感じてしまう。
blocks.translation: For a SaGa game, numerical inflation is kept relatively restrained. Since it is difficult to get the satisfaction of developing your characters, it may feel a little lacking. Because characters do not grow immediately after winning battles, battles can start to feel like a chore.

blocks.source: 最初はとっつきにくいだけで、実は慣れれば面白い作品なのではないかと期待していた。
blocks.translation: At first, I expected it to be a game that was merely difficult to get into but would actually become enjoyable once I got used to it.

blocks.source: ……が、慣れてくると単純なアラのほうが目に付いてくる。独特のシステムの多くが、面白さよりも『とっつきにくさ』『テンポの悪さ』につながっているのがなんとも。
blocks.translation: …But as I became accustomed to it, its simple flaws began to stand out more. It is unfortunate that many of its unique systems contribute more to its “inaccessibility” and “poor pacing” than to its fun.

blocks.source: 快適性
blocks.translation: Convenience

blocks.source: システムの都合上、戦闘を回避しにくい。やっぱりシンボルエンカウントと比べると、納得行かないことが多い。
blocks.translation: Due to the way the system works, it is difficult to avoid battles. Compared with visible enemy encounters, there are simply too many situations that feel unreasonable.

blocks.source: リール等のシステムによって、戦闘テンポが遅く時間がかかる。
blocks.translation: Systems such as the reels slow the pace of battles and make them take a long time.

blocks.source: 武器に耐久度が存在するが『武器修理』の能力があれば、いくらでも修理できる。でも、それだと回数が減るたびに修理する手間がかかるだけのような……。それだったら耐久度とかいらなくね？
blocks.translation: Weapons have durability, but with the Weapon Repair ability, you can repair them as many times as you like. Still, that seems to do nothing more than make you go through the trouble of repairing them every time their uses decrease… If that's all it does, why have durability at all?

blocks.source: 鍛冶屋で特定の組み合わせで素材を合成した時に、一定確率で良い武器防具を作成することができる。しかし、こういうシステムはリセット作業ゲーを誘発するのも世の定め。そのために、何度もリセットする必要があるのが面倒。
blocks.translation: When you combine materials in specific combinations at the blacksmith's, you have a set chance of creating good weapons and armor. However, it is only natural for systems like this to encourage reset-based gameplay. Having to reset over and over for that reason is a nuisance.

blocks.source: 奇抜なシステムばかりが話題になるゲームだけど、基本的な部分の快適性もかなり微妙。戦闘テンポはシリーズ中では遅めだし、ロード時間は普通に長い。
blocks.translation: This game is known mainly for its unusual systems, but even its basic conveniences are rather questionable. Battle pacing is on the slower side for the series, and the loading times are plainly long.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Visuals

blocks.source: 独特のグラフィックは味がある。特に戦闘画面は後発のミンストレルソングよりもキレイだと思う。キャラクターの立ち絵だけで進行するイベントなど、随所に手抜き感が漂ってはいるけれど……。
blocks.translation: The distinctive graphics have a certain charm. In particular, I think the battle screens look better than those in the later Minstrel Song. Still, events that progress using only character portraits and other elements give off an unfinished feel here and there…

blocks.source: なお、タイトルデモの完成度が音楽と相まって妙に高く、それだけ見ると非常に面白そうに見える。
blocks.translation: The title demo is surprisingly polished, especially when combined with the music, and viewed on its own, it makes the game look extremely interesting.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: サガフロンティア２に続いて作曲は浜渦正志が担当。音楽はこのゲームにおいて、最も普通にほめられる点。というか、曲が良すぎて作曲者が不憫なほど。その中でも通常戦闘曲の評価は高い。いいっすよね主旋律がバイオリンの戦闘曲って。
blocks.translation: Following SaGa Frontier 2, Masashi Hamauzu handled the composition. Music is the easiest thing to praise about this game. In fact, the songs are so good that I almost feel sorry for the composer. The regular battle theme is particularly highly regarded. Battle music with a violin carrying the main melody is great, isn't it?

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Summary

blocks.source: とにかく、変わった作品を作ろうという意欲は感じたのだけど「変わったゲーム＝おもしろいゲーム」という訳ではないし、単純に作りこみの甘い部分も多く見られる。
blocks.translation: In any case, I could feel the desire to create something unusual, but unusual game ≠ fun game, and there are also many areas that simply feel underdeveloped.

blocks.source: 音楽やグラフィックなどの雰囲気は非常に良いので、変わったシステムが好きで、かつ手応えを求めるゲーマーなら意外と楽しめるかもしれない。
blocks.translation: The atmosphere created by the music and graphics is excellent, so gamers who like unusual systems and are looking for a challenge may find it surprisingly enjoyable.

blocks.source: なお、一般にプレイする際は別売説明書（解体真書）が推奨されているらしい。とはいえ、今の時代はネットにも詳しい攻略情報がたくさんあるし、あえて、自分でいけるところまで攻略法を模索するのも面白いかと思う。
blocks.translation: Apparently, the separately sold guidebook (Kaitai Shinsho) is generally recommended when playing. That said, there is plenty of detailed strategy information online these days, and I think it can be fun to deliberately work out your own strategy as far as you can.
